classification: obsolete synthetic terminal after same-net producer reroute
mechanism: A previously satisfied branch remains tied to a coarse interior point when its producer is rerouted. The transient victim failure is invisible to retained-missing-request rebind logic.
proof: Two saved-copper replay transactions complete after producer-backed real-pad rebind, preserving pad components and adding zero DRC violations.
scope: One bounded rebind retry inside atomic singleton/coupled repair; no clearance relaxation or board-specific selection.
known_limit: Chained rebinding through an earlier rebound victim is conservatively rejected in the same transaction.
